entries.original_title: Amazon Bedrock document history updated
entries.subtitle: Amazon Bedrock now supports retrieval instructions for managed knowledge bases and Standard-tier grounding checks for reasoning or conversational responses.
entries.reject_reason: The Bedrock document-history change lists incremental features but announces neither a new model nor a major product launch.

entries.original_title: Perplexity API changelog updated
entries.subtitle: The Perplexity API changelog adds approval controls for MCP and connector tool calls, so teams can review calls before they run.
entries.reject_reason: The Perplexity changelog adds incremental API controls and preset changes, not a new model or major product launch.

entries.original_title: Anthropic Transparency Hub updated
entries.subtitle: Anthropic's Transparency Hub now describes Claude Haiku 5.5 as its fastest, most capable small model for high-volume tasks such as summarization and subagents.
entries.reject_reason: The transparency-page change describes Claude Haiku 5.5 but does not establish a model launch or a material safety or usage policy change.

entries.original_title: Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
entries.subtitle: Amazon Bedrock now offers SpaceXAI Grok 4.7 in AWS GovCloud (US), with improved document handling, coding, and browser-use agents.
entries.reject_reason: This is regional Bedrock availability for an existing Grok model, not the model's launch.

entries.original_title: Securing the agentic insider
entries.subtitle: Microsoft warns that enterprise AI agents can act unpredictably with broad access, so organizations need continuous monitoring and security.
entries.reject_reason: This discusses risks from enterprise agents and an existing security project without announcing a new feature or research result.

entries.original_title: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help
entries.subtitle: Germany and NVIDIA plan a joint initiative to advance AI models for physical AI, linking the country's engineering and manufacturing strengths with AI research.
entries.reject_reason: NVIDIA and Germany announce an intention to collaborate on physical AI, not a completed research result or launched product.

entries.original_title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now available in additional AWS Regions
entries.subtitle: Amazon CloudWatch Omni expands to eight AWS Regions, giving teams a shared way to monitor and troubleshoot applications and agents across clouds.
entries.reject_reason: CloudWatch Omni's expansion to additional regions does not introduce a new product or feature.

entries.original_title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production
entries.subtitle: NVIDIA and EBU are expanding sovereign AI standards for broadcasters, while Adobe Frame.io uses NVIDIA GPUs to help UFA find video moments faster.
entries.reject_reason: The broadcaster and media collaborations extend standards and deployments without clearly launching a new NVIDIA product or presenting research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
entries.subtitle: OpenVLHarness combines persistent multimodal memory and external tools to support visual reasoning, and the study evaluates it across 22 benchmarks.
entries.reject_reason: The third-party harness paper benchmarks tracked companies' models but is not research from those entities.

entries.original_title: Paper page - MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
entries.subtitle: MemT-1.0 embeds ongoing memory in foundation-model computation, aiming to improve long-context efficiency and performance on agentic tasks.
entries.reject_reason: MemT-1.0 is research from MemTensor displayed on a tracker page, not a development by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Spain-Based Startups Advance Regional Innovation With Barcelona Supercomputing Center
entries.subtitle: Startups can now access some Barcelona Supercomputing Center AI Factory services through NVIDIA Inception, expanding support from a programme that delivered more than 800 services.
entries.reject_reason: The article primarily profiles startups and access to an existing accelerator, without a substantive NVIDIA launch or research result.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
entries.subtitle: The paper proposes collective robot learning from fleet experience, using failures to retrieve successful trajectories and improve a shared policy without expert corrections.
entries.reject_reason: The tracker hosts a third-party robotics paper rather than reporting research by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
entries.subtitle: EgoXperience uses large-scale annotated egocentric video to reconstruct camera motion, scenes, hands, and objects together in one model.
entries.reject_reason: The tracker page describes third-party egocentric-video research rather than work by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Accelerating Mamba-2 with High-Performance Forward Pass Kernels in NVIDIA CUDA Tile
entries.subtitle: The article describes high-performance forward-pass kernels in NVIDIA CUDA Tile to accelerate Mamba-2.
entries.reject_reason: This CUDA Tile kernel article describes an implementation technique without a clearly stated new research result or product launch.

entries.original_title: Amazon announces plan to invest €16 billion in Germany in 2027
entries.subtitle: Amazon plans to invest more than €16 billion in Germany in 2027 across data centers, AI infrastructure, satellite links, logistics, and Prime Video.
entries.reject_reason: Amazon's broad investment plan includes AI infrastructure but is not itself a product launch or research result.

entries.original_title: Paper page - ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
entries.subtitle: ScaleNav trains robot navigation from internet egocentric videos, using language goals to guide actions in simulated and real-world settings.
entries.reject_reason: ScaleNav is third-party robotics research displayed by a tracker rather than a development by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
entries.subtitle: HOLI-WORLD turns egocentric recordings into learning resources that link scenes, objects, and interactions, with less dependence on manual annotation.
entries.reject_reason: This is a third-party world-intelligence paper hosted on a tracker, not research by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
entries.subtitle: The study uses low-rank adapters to adapt multimodal models up to 104B parameters for brain-response prediction with lower computational cost.
entries.reject_reason: Mentioning a Qwen backbone does not make this third-party brain-encoding paper research by a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
entries.subtitle: SpecMRL reorganizes embedding features to preserve useful information in smaller representations, and outperforms standard MRL at reduced dimensions.
entries.reject_reason: SpecMRL is a research paper by authors who are not identified as belonging to a tracked entity; the tracked paper site is only hosting it.

entries.original_title: Paper page - MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
entries.subtitle: MT Forcing combines two training methods to reduce visual drift and preserve image details across multiple editing turns.
entries.reject_reason: The image-editing method is attributed to SenseNova, which is not tracked, while the tracked paper site merely hosts the page.

entries.original_title: From AI That Answers to AI That Acts
entries.subtitle: AMD argues physical AI needs systems measured for responsiveness, predictability, power, and safety, because robots act in real-world settings near people.
entries.reject_reason: AMD's physical-AI article is a perspective on performance metrics rather than a new result or launch.

entries.original_title: 20 Video Ideas for Content Creators to Try
entries.subtitle: Kling AI's guide offers 20 video ideas and advice to shape them for audiences and optimize them for YouTube, TikTok or Shorts.
entries.reject_reason: This is a creator-ideas guide using an existing Kling model, not a launch or research result.

entries.original_title: Broadcom to Advance NTT DOCOMO’s Private Cloud with VMware Cloud Foundation
entries.subtitle: Broadcom's 10-year VMware Cloud Foundation agreement with NTT DOCOMO aims to strengthen private-cloud resilience and support next-generation services in Japan.
entries.reject_reason: Broadcom's ten-year VMware agreement is a customer contract, not a new product or research development.

entries.original_title: Amazon invests in nuclear energy project targeting nearly 1 gigawatt of carbon-free energy for Indiana
entries.subtitle: Amazon, X-energy, and AEP will explore 12 reactors in Indiana, targeting 960 megawatts of carbon-free power for the grid and Amazon data centers.
entries.reject_reason: The proposed nuclear-energy project concerns future power supply rather than a new AI product or research result.

entries.original_title: New repository deepseek-ai/DeepInfer: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
entries.subtitle: DeepSeek released DeepInfer, an open-source inference framework for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with kernels, parallel processing, scheduling, and structured outputs.
entries.reject_reason: DeepInfer is a GitHub repository upload for an inference framework, not a new named model or model version.

entries.original_title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
entries.subtitle: Amazon RDS Custom now supports SQL Server 2019 CU32+GDR KB5122772 and SQL Server 2022 CU26 + GDR KB5122768.
entries.reject_reason: Support for routine SQL Server cumulative and security updates is not a substantive product launch.

entries.original_title: Best AI Image Editing Tools for Photos, Design, and Creative Projects
entries.subtitle: Kling AI compares seven image editing tools and explains how Kling IMAGE 3.0 Omni uses references, targeted edits, and image expansion.
entries.reject_reason: This comparison guide promotes existing image-editing tools without announcing a new capability.

entries.original_title: AI Image Editing Model Comparison for Everyday Edits
entries.subtitle: The article compares six AI image editing products by access and workflow, and describes how Kling IMAGE 3.0 Omni edits images.
entries.reject_reason: This article compares existing image-editing products rather than reporting a launch or research result.

entries.original_title: How to Animate Old Photos: A Step-by-Step AI Guide
entries.subtitle: The guide explains how to animate old photos with AI, using prompts, reference materials, and editing tips in Kling 4.0.
entries.reject_reason: This is a how-to guide for animating photos with an existing Kling model.

entries.original_title: How to Enhance Video Quality? Fixes for Blur, Noise, and More
entries.subtitle: Kling AI outlines ways to address lighting, blur, and compression problems, including prompt-guided edits and 1080p or 4K output.
entries.reject_reason: The video-quality article explains existing tools rather than announcing an update.

entries.original_title: Best AI Tattoo Generator: How to Design a Tattoo You Will Actually Get
entries.subtitle: Kling AI's guide compares AI tattoo generators and explains how prompts and reference photos can produce designs for refinement with a tattoo artist.
entries.reject_reason: The tattoo-design article is a usage guide for existing Kling capabilities.

entries.original_title: “Memory-Centric Server Systems Are the Future”: SK hynix Presents Its Next-Generation AI Infrastructure Vision at OCP Global Summit 2026
entries.subtitle: SK hynix presented its next-generation AI infrastructure vision at OCP Global Summit 2026, emphasizing memory-centric server systems.
entries.reject_reason: The supplied text identifies an SK hynix infrastructure-vision presentation but gives no concrete new result or launch.

entries.original_title: AI Art: What It Is and How to Create Your Own
entries.subtitle: Kling AI explains how to make AI art from text and image references, refine styles, and create consistent illustration series.
entries.reject_reason: This AI-art tutorial does not introduce a model, product feature, or research result.

entries.original_title: A Smarter Model Won’t Save Your Bad Harness | Cerebras
entries.subtitle: Cerebras argues that an AI agent's harness, which controls tools, feedback, and task completion, matters as much as the model's intelligence.
entries.reject_reason: Cerebras explains agent-harness concepts without presenting a new technique, measured result, or product.

entries.original_title: Navan cuts a month-long migration down to a week, without freezing the codebase · Cursor
entries.subtitle: Navan used Cursor Cloud Agents to migrate 8 applications and 15 libraries in about a week without freezing development.
entries.reject_reason: Navan's migration is a customer case study about an existing Cursor feature.

entries.original_title: amd/CAE-FastWAM
entries.subtitle: AMD uploaded CAE-FastWAM, a LIBERO benchmark policy fine-tuned from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B for robot actions.

entries.subtitle: The German-language film Drive – The Pretenders arrives worldwide on Prime Video October 28, following a mechanic and a scandal-hit racing star.
